method.basis: Deterministic reproduction of the shipped ATL-140 four-row Malkom requirements crosswalk against governed package/readiness/projection-boundary/client-binding artifacts.

requirements.atlasSupplies: Exact scope, version, WorkDefinition/package and source lineage.
requirements.malkomAvoidsRediscovering: Canonical process/work identity, version and source lineage.

requirements.atlasSupplies: Required inputs, decision, rule, control, evidence, action and outcome semantics.
requirements.malkomAvoidsRediscovering: Pickup work definition, four required input classes, decision/rule/control/evidence, action and outcome structure.
requirements.residual: No semantic rediscovery for this bounded WorkDefinition; implementation still consumes the supplied structure.

requirements.atlasSupplies: Explicit binding ID, expected source/system/authority and collection question; two related demo bindings are already resolved.
requirements.malkomAvoidsRediscovering: The fact, location and governance of the missing client-specific execution dependency.
requirements.residual: Authorized client/master-data owner must supply governed pickup execution parameters/approved values before projection can execute.

requirements.atlasSupplies: Machine-readable JSON export and explicit no-guessed-interface disposition.
requirements.malkomAvoidsRediscovering: No false endpoint is implied; current handoff format is explicit.
requirements.residual: Confirm whether an API endpoint is actually required and, if so, define/configure that interface outside this bounded proof.

residualDiscovery.question: Which governed client/master execution parameters and approved values apply to this pickup request?
Does Malkom require an API endpoint beyond the governed machine-readable JSON export?

limitations: Single representative Road LTL/LTL-04 scope only.
No savings, effort reduction or economic benefit is claimed because governed evidence does not quantify them.
No statistically robust enterprise study, cross-runtime comparison or final product kill decision.
Projection remains fail-closed while the required client execution-parameters binding is unresolved.
